sloka: चीरे गृहीते तु तया समीक्ष्य नृपतेर्गुरुः ।निवार्य सीताम् कैकेयीम् वसिष्ठो वाक्यमब्रवीत् ॥२-३७-२१॥
transliteration: cīre gṛhīte tu tayā samīkṣya nṛpaterguruḥ ।nivārya sītām kaikeyīm vasiṣṭho vākyamabravīt ॥2-37-21॥

translations.english: When Sita wore the bark garments, Vasistha, the king's preceptor who was watching this restrained her (Sita) and said to Kaikeyi:
